components.name: Ink Button
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-ink"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 4.5v15l12-7.5z"/></svg>Start</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 560 13px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform .12s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-ink { background: var(--btn-ink); color: var(--btn-ink-text); } .ds-ink:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--btn-ink) 86%, var(--indigo)); } .ds-ink:active { transform: scale(.965); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn-d { height: 30px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill-2); color: var(--ink); font: 560 13px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .12s; } .ds-btn-d:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fill-2) 100%, var(--ink) 6%); } .ds-btn-d:active { transform: scale(.965); } .ds-btn-d:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger and Confirm
components.description: Destructive action: red text first, solid red on the confirm click.
components.css: .ds-danger { height: 30px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill-2); color: var(--red); font: 560 13px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-danger:active { transform: scale(.965); } .ds-confirm { background: var(--red); color: #fff; } .ds-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Phones / Test runs switch and inspector tabs.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill-2); } .ds-seg button { height: 26px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font: 560 13px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s, color .18s; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg button[aria-selected=true] { background: var(--card-solid); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px var(--shadow), 0 0 0 .5px var(--line); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field on a fill ground.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--fill); color: var(--ink); font: 13px var(--ui); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: State Pill
components.description: Dot plus label; dot colour carries state.
components.html: RunningWarming upFailed
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 560 11.5px var(--ui); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-3); } .ds-run::before { background: var(--green); } .ds-warm::before { background: var(--amber); animation: ds-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-fail { color: var(--red); } .ds-fail::before { background: var(--red); } @keyframes ds-breathe { from { opacity: .35; } to { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Inspector Card
components.description: Frosted card beside the focused phone.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 300px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--card); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px var(--line-2), 0 12px 34px -18px var(--shadow); color: var(--ink); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 650 24px/1.1 var(--disp); letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-facts { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--fill); font: 12px var(--ui); } .ds-facts dt { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Phone on the Sweep
components.description: Signature: phone object with bezel rings, contact shadow and caption; selected state lifts with an indigo ring.
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 92px; display: grid; gap: 9px; } .ds-phone { aspect-ratio: 1320 / 2868; border-radius: 13% / 6%; background: var(--glass); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / .55), rgb(255 255 255 / .10)), 0 0 0 3.5px light-dark(#2b2a28, #2c2c2f), 0 0 0 4.5px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / .25), rgb(255 255 255 / .14)), 0 14px 26px -12px var(--shadow), 0 26px 30px -26px var(--shadow); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-phone { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / .55), rgb(255 255 255 / .10)), 0 0 0 3.5px light-dark(#2b2a28, #2c2c2f), 0 0 0 6.5px var(--indigo), 0 22px 34px -14px var(--shadow), 0 34px 36px -28px var(--shadow); } .ds-cap { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; font: 11.5px var(--ui); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-cap b { font: 650 13.5px var(--disp); color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -.01em; }

narrative.overview:
The Fleet is a product shoot. Eight phones stand on a seamless cove that fades from a darker wall to a pale floor, each one a physical object: black glass in a thin bezel with a soft contact shadow under it, and a quiet caption under that. The focused phone stands large beside them, with a frosted inspector card at its side. By day the sweep is warm paper grey; by night it is deep graphite. Both themes come from the same tokens through `light-dark()`.

Everything around the phones is quiet material: a translucent toolbar over the sweep, frosted cards, near-black ink pill buttons (white in dark mode). Hue appears only to report state (green running, amber warming, red fault) and in one reserved colour, indigo, for focus, selection and the thing your hand is on. The type is the system face, set with tight tracking and tabular figures.

Motion is short and physical. A booting phone's glass warms up like studio lights coming on, through four phase marks, and gives one soft glint when it is ready. Buttons press in to 96.5%, the selected phone rises 4px, and popovers and toasts settle in over about 0.2s. Reduced motion removes all of it.
keyCharacteristics: Seamless sweep ground: a vertical gradient plus a soft light pool behind the grid.
Phones are objects: black glass, layered bezel rings, two-part contact shadow, true 1320 x 2868 aspect.
Translucent and frosted surfaces (`backdrop-filter` blur) over the sweep, never opaque slabs.
Ink pill buttons; state colour only as a dot or text, never as a fill, except for the confirm step.
Indigo is reserved for focus, selection, drop targets and touch traces.

rules.name: The One Reserved Colour Rule
rules.body: Indigo means "this one, here, now": focus, selection, a drop target, a touch. It is never used for state or decoration.

rules.name: The State Dot Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear as a 7px dot, a text colour or a thin mark. The only solid red fill is the second click of a destructive action.

rules.name: The Steady Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates (RAM, fps, counts, uptime, durations) uses `tabular-nums` so it does not jitter.

rules.name: The Lit Object Rule
rules.body: Phones and floating things cast soft shadows; chrome is frosted instead. Shadows are always soft and offset downward, never hard.

dos: Do take every colour from the `:root` tokens and their `light-dark()` pairs, so both themes stay in step.
Do keep all eight phones on the sweep, at true 1320 x 2868 aspect, with bezel and contact shadow.
Do show state as a dot or text colour in green, amber or red.
Do use indigo only for focus, selection, drop targets and touch traces.
Do use ink pill buttons, one ink primary per region.
Do set changing numbers in tabular figures.
Do confirm destructive actions in place: red text first, solid red only on the second click.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing transitions and animations.
donts: Don't replace the phone grid with a table or list of Devices beside a single viewer.
Don't fill buttons or surfaces with state colours, except the confirm step.
Don't use indigo to show state or as decoration.
Don't use hard offset shadows; every shadow is soft and lit from above.
Don't put opaque slabs over the sweep; chrome is translucent or frosted.
